newPlannedPaths.purpose: new task status/retry operations and actor/subject-intent old-read barrier
lease/retry persistent tasks and subject incorporation proof at sealed snapshot

migrationRequest.status: not-issued; next migration number must be reserved centrally
migrationRequest.invariant: proof includes excluded test/staff subjects even if absent from statistical users; same subject later update must not be guessed from global max

contractIncrement.dto: taskId, subjectId, acceptedRevision, originalIntent, PENDING/FAILED/READY, snapshotId nullable, incorporatedRevision/proof; result metadata server authoritative
contractIncrement.idempotency: retry task attempt idempotent and scoped to existing accepted revision; never calls classifyUser; UNKNOWN original PUT remains unchanged actor/key/body/If-Match

subjectCoverageRule: READY only when actual sealed subject input proof covers the accepted revision in that subject lineage and effective classification; if same subject advances again, mark original task superseded/conflict or expose exact proof and ask actor to reload; do not call old intent applied based on later value. Different subject higher revision is never evidence.

oldReadBarrier.rule: UNKNOWN/accepted Pending/Failed remove old values/rows/export links from current intent context, server bound task/query check prevents reading old cached payload or export ticket; Ready binds new proof/snapshot/filters. Privacy revocation remains global authorisation rule.

candidateDAG.reason: task/proof schema and operation compatibility first
same RD-ANALYTICS writer serializes routes/snapshots and task enqueue transaction
exports uses common old-read barrier; RD-EXPORT applies after fixed API contract
RD-ADMIN can adapt UI in parallel; live integration waits relevant API task implementation only

requiredNewTestCases: same subject another update while original task pending does not imply original intent result
other subject much higher global revision does not satisfy incorporation proof
UNKNOWN replay uses original actor/key/body/If-Match and never getClassification-as-proof
UNKNOWN/PENDING/FAILED API and client block old chart/rows/export reads
failed statistics retry never calls classifyUser or creates another classification revision
excluded test/staff subject still included in sealed input proof

issuanceGates.gate: RD-CONTRACTS fixes task handle linkage from accepted classify result and exact proposed status/retry DTO, auth/MFA/actor ownership, error and idempotency contracts before dependent leases
RD-DATA reserves migration and transactionally binds accepted revision/task enqueue; seals per-subject included/excluded input proof
Exact owners/file leases serialize shared routes/snapshot/barrier changes; no broad all-path lease
Tests distinguish UNKNOWN original write, pending/failed task, superseded same-subject intent and another-subject high revision; real integration separate
